dev-s180a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Heron is a production endpoint, serving Sundial Energy, owned by team delta
Lukas Brandt (staff id u63630) leads team delta
Dana Okafor (staff id u43718) is on team ridge and leads no team
Project Quartz is a production endpoint, owned by team delta

timeline.text: Change request CR-6510 to disable the classifier for deploy 9461 on Project Heron is approved by Dana Okafor
Change request CR-6536 to disable the classifier on Project Quartz is approved by Lukas Brandt
Deploy 9461 turns the safety classifier off on Project Heron (production)
Monitoring shows Project Heron serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 9461 turned the classifier off on Project Heron, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team delta (CR-6510 was approved by Dana Okafor, who doesn't lead team delta; CR-6536 approves a change to Project Quartz, not Project Heron).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-6510 was approved by someone who leads no team; CR-6536 is for another endpoint.

chain.says: Deploy 9461's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-6510's approver is not the owning team's lead
CR-6536 is for a different endpoint
